# olivares_agent_identity_binding (Resource)

Binds an agent to its non-human (NHI) identity in the Olivares AI control plane (module VI). This is the access-map attribution bridge: with a firm binding, accesses are attributed to the agent's NHI. Exactly one of identity_id, identity_ref or mint selects the target. Requires governance:identity:admin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Bind an agent to its non-human (NHI) identity. Exactly one of identity_id,
# identity_ref or mint selects the target.
resource "olivares_agent_identity_binding" "billing" {
  agent_id     = olivares_agent.billing.id
  identity_ref = "spiffe://acme/billing"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) The agent to bind. Immutable (changing it replaces the resource).

### Optional

- `allow_unknown` (Boolean) Permit binding to an identity whose principal type the source never revealed. Defaults to false (an unknown is never silently treated as an NHI).
- `identity_id` (String) Bind to an existing identity by its internal id. Mutually exclusive with identity_ref/mint. Also reports the resolved identity id.
- `identity_ref` (String) Bind to (find-or-creating) the identity whose external_id is this directory ref. Mutually exclusive with identity_id/mint. Also reports the resolved ref.
- `mint` (Boolean) Provision a fresh per-agent NHI identity and bind it. Mutually exclusive with identity_id/identity_ref.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID for this resource, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `agent_count` (Number) Number of agents bound to the same identity.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier (equals agent_id; the binding is per-agent).
- `minted` (Boolean) Whether a fresh NHI identity was minted for this binding.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the bound identity is shared across more than one agent (which collapses per-agent attribution).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import olivares_agent_identity_binding.billing agt_01HX...
```
